Strong sunlight casts sharp shadows of the window bars onto the interior wall and floor.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the iron bars and the window frame. AI often fails to render the physical connection points correctly, causing bars to float or merge into the masonry. Also, verify that the shadow angles match the light source coming from the exterior.
